description: This file contains utility classes and functions for tracing, particularly related to symbolic tracing within PyTorch's FX module. It defines data structures for configuring tracing, recording parameter usage, and tracking execution order during module calls in a distributed setting.

classes.name: TracingConfig
classes.description: Dataclass representing the configuration for symbolic tracing, including the tracer instance and concrete arguments.

classes.name: _ParamUsageInfo
classes.description: NamedTuple used to record parameter usage information within a module during tracing.

classes.name: _ExecutionInfo
classes.description: Class capturing the state and order of modules and parameters during the forward pass for tracing purposes.

classes.name: _ExecOrderTracer
classes.description: Utility class that patches the tracer to record execution and parameter usage during symbolic tracing, supporting context management.

methods.name: Any _patched_call_module( self, call_module: Callable, exec_info: _ExecutionInfo, module: nn.Module, forward: Callable, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Overrides the module call to record execution order and parameter usage during symbolic tracing.

methods.name: torch.fx.Proxy _patched_create_proxy( self, create_proxy: Callable, exec_info: _ExecutionInfo, fqn_to_param: dict[str, nn.Parameter], kind: str, target: torch.fx.node.Target, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any], name: str | None = None, type_expr: Any | None = None, proxy_factory_fn: Callable[[torch.fx.Node], torch.fx.Proxy] | None = None, )
methods.description: Overrides the creation of FX proxies to record when parameters and modules are accessed or called during tracing.

ctags.signature: ( self, call_module: Callable, exec_info: _ExecutionInfo, module: nn.Module, forward: Callable, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any], )

ctags.signature: ( self, create_proxy: Callable, exec_info: _ExecutionInfo, fqn_to_param: dict[str, nn.Parameter], kind: str, target: torch.fx.node.Target, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any], name: str | None = None, type_expr: Any | None = None, proxy_factory_fn: Callable[[torch.fx.Node], torch.fx.Proxy] | None = None, )
